Calls; the arrow points from the caller

C4 model, level 2. Each participant runs the connector and the identity. Public ports go through the participant's HTTPS reverse proxy; internal ones never do (DEPLOYING). Participants trust the issuer's DID, its bundle key and, for Gaia-X offers, the compliance services they list. The

website is not part of it. The management ports also answer the health checks, without the API key; traces and metrics go to the operator's observability backend only when OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set (ADR 0023).
